# Locked Svelte 4 support

This profile tests the current realtime checkout as an installed package. It covers RPC, ordinary stream stores, production SSR, browser updates and declaration checking. Svelte 5 rune features remain outside this profile; see [version compatibility](../README.md#version-compatibility).

<!-- Generated by scripts/check-svelte-support.js from the fixture manifest and lockfile. -->
| Node | Svelte | SvelteKit | Vite | Svelte Vite plugin | svelte-check | Adapter | Realtime |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22.12.0 | 4.2.20 | 2.70.2 | 5.4.21 | 3.1.2 | 3.8.6 | 0.6.0-next.95 | 0.6.0-next.91 (checkout) |

Use Node 22.12.0 from the fixture .nvmrc, then run these commands from the repository root:

~~~sh
cd test/fixtures/svelte4
npm ci --install-links
npm exec -- svelte-adapter-uws-preflight
npm exec -- playwright install --with-deps chromium
npm run build
npm run check
npm run stores
npm run smoke
~~~

Build precedes type checking because the realtime Vite plugin generates the $live declarations. The store check verifies subscribe/hydrate/map plus the explicit Svelte 5-only rune boundary. The browser check starts the production build on a free loopback port, checks two tabs and reload, then stops the server. Its demo identity accepts local test clients; it is not deployment authentication.

The dedicated Svelte 4 CI job runs beside the existing Svelte 5 verification and browser fixtures. npm ci --install-links installs the locked dependencies and packages this checkout, rather than resolving a published realtime version. This is a framework compatibility check, not a claim that a new coordinated release tuple has been published.

When changing package dependencies, regenerate this fixture lock with npm install --package-lock-only --install-links --ignore-scripts inside the fixture, then run node scripts/check-svelte-support.js --write from the repository root and repeat all checks above. The root check gate rejects manifest, lockfile, generated documentation and CI drift, plus tracked build/.svelte-kit/node_modules artifacts at any directory depth.
